subject: Next steps: POC prompt/log collection + evaluation playbook
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@prospectco.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Next steps: POC prompt/log collection + evaluation playbook

Hi Sam — thanks again for the call this morning. Short recap and proposed next steps so we have a single place to track items for the POC: 

Summary of what we heard
- Success criteria: 1) 20% reduction in average handle time on support triage tasks (measured on your gold test set), 2) >= 92% precision on intent classification for the top 10 intents, 3) user acceptance >= 85% on a blind review sample.
- Scope: initial POC will run against a subset of your support logs + synthetic prompt variations for product FAQs.
- Constraints: data must be sanitized (PII removed) before upload; team prefers S3-based transfer.

Proposed evaluation plan and timeline
- Week 0 (this week): sign DPA + team access; we provide an upload playbook.
- Week 1: ProspectCo uploads 10k-20k sanitized prompts/logs to the S3 path we provide.
- Week 2: Redwood runs baseline runs (current model baseline + one tuned variant).
- Week 3: Joint review of evaluation metrics, sample outputs, and qualitative feedback; iterate.

Ownership
- ProspectCo: Sam (data owner) and Lee (security lead) — responsible for sanitization and upload.
- Redwood: Irene (eng sponsor) for evaluation runs and Marcus (solutions engineer) for ingestion tooling and sample analysis.

Immediate asks (please):
1) Please confirm you can deliver a sanitized sample of ~10k prompt/log pairs by Tue 2026-12-01. If not, tell us an alternate date.
2) Confirm that your security team is OK with our DPA and the S3 transfer approach. 
3) Tell us if you want us to provide a one-off scrubbing script (we can run on your samples) or if you'll do in-house.

I've attached a short playbook (prompt-upload-instructions.pdf) with the exact CSV spec, recommended redaction checklist, and a sample CSV (sample-prompt-log.csv). Also attaching our standard data processing addendum for legal (redwood-data-processing-addendum.pdf).

If that all looks good I'll provision the S3 path and send the upload instructions + a HubSpot link with action items for both teams.

Thanks — Irene

--
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

From: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@prospectco.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lee Harper <lee.harper@prospectco.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: POC prompt/log collection + evaluation playbook

Irene — thanks for the clear recap. Quick responses inline: 

On success criteria: agreed on the targets you listed; we'll add the handle-time measurement definition (start/end events) and share it with you by Monday so metrics are aligned.

Data availability: we have ~12k past support tickets that match the scope. We'll sanitize and aim to upload 10k by Wed 2026-12-02. Lee (cc) is our security lead and will confirm whether our standard scrubbing pipeline meets your checklist. If not, we'd appreciate the one-off script you mentioned.

A couple of Qs: 
- Can you confirm retention on the S3 upload? We need to ensure files are auto-deleted after 60 days unless we request longer.
- Do you need any entitlement or role mapping from our side for access to the S3 path?

We signed the initial MSA in principle; legal asked for the DPA before upload. I'll route the DPA to our counsel today.

Thanks,
Sam

Sam — great, thank you. Quick answers: 

Retention: S3 path is provisioned with lifecycle that auto-deletes after 60 days by default; we can extend retention per request but will require an explicit retention flag in the upload ticket.
Access: we'll create an IAM role for a one-time cross-account role (read-only) and provide temporary credentials. If you prefer to push the objects to our bucket, we'll give you the bucket prefix and a pre-signed upload script.

Marcus — can you send the one-off scrubbing script and the pre-signed upload instructions? Also please provision the S3 prefix: s3://redwood-poc-uploads/prospectco/2026-11/ and add lifecycle rules as noted.

Sam — once Lee confirms the DPA is OK, we'll mark the upload ticket and track the Tue/Wed target. I'll create a HubSpot action with these dates and assignees and share the link here.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to getting data in.

Best,
Irene

--
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
